title: Payment for loss to multiple consumers

content.scenario: A pharmaceutical company sells a defective medicine that causes harm to hundreds of consumers. The District Commission orders the company to pay a sum determined by it, which is at least twenty-five per cent of the value of the defective medicine, as compensation to the affected consumers.
content.outcome: The company pays the determined sum to the consumers, and the consumers receive compensation for the harm caused by the defective medicine.
